lore_anchors.definition: A sealed sub-realm where cultivators lose all magical power due to the Spirit Void Eruption; inhabited by Yin Beasts and survivors.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What exactly is the Netherworld Domain?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a sealed sub-realm filled with Netherworld force where cultivators lose all magical power due to the Spirit Void Eruption phenomenon; it is believed to be either a spatial rift to the underworld or the belly of a legendary demon beast called the Luohou.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Han Li use his magical power here?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Netherworld Domain is periodically flooded by the Spirit Void Eruption, a mana-sealing energy that suppresses all supernatural abilities; as long as he stays in this space, his cultivation techniques will not work.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is there really a way out of the Netherworld Domain?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The only known method is climbing Stormwind Mountain, but it is considered nearly impossible by the local survivors; the elder warns that attempting it is often suicidal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Luohou beast theory?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Some believe the Netherworld Domain is actually inside the belly of a legendary demon beast called the Luohou, which can swallow the sun and moon and tear through space, explaining why the domain connects to different sea regions at different times.
He is a cultivator from the Great Jin Dynasty who was pulled into the Netherworld Domain long ago; he serves as a village elder and provides information to new arrivals.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Great Jin Dynasty?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Great Jin Dynasty is a super-empire in the cultivation world, considered by its natives to be the "holy land" of cultivators; it is a larger and more prosperous region than the Heavenly South or the Chaotic Star Sea.
